items.text:
**No concrete blocker found in the reviewed EXP-07 checkpoint scope. Final module acceptance remains pending.**

I reviewed frozen implementation `6d840c4d…` against the amended contract and [checkpoint `b4043233…`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/b4043233974489422316344c530dd9677f377dc3/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-exp07-post-recovery/EXECUTION_CHECKPOINT.md), including separate source reviews of timing and gameplay consumers.

The inspected implementation preserves the governing boundaries:

- Exact old-defender Start admission follows actual party Ends and eligible Grounding settlement. Failed contact commits elapsed consequences and requires a fresh approach.
- The NPC carries its genuine off-calendar interval. Party expenditures carry forward; superseded calendars retain effect deadlines without refreshing current allowances.
- Fear histories/recharge remain owner-specific. Existing Rite, Radiance and six-spell behavior use the new owning calendar while preserving payment, authority, cure and concentration rules.
- New-opponent authority precedes duplicate disclosure. Restoration checks preserve genesis, source and historical provenance.
- Actual death and outgoing-slot closure create the separate archive without repeating the earlier milestone.

**Independent reconciliation completed:**

- Exact **35 engine / 16 documentation-support files**, with an empty subsequent engine diff; `249c942a4…` changes support only.
- All **172 indexed artifacts / 19,617,164 bytes** against Git blob identities, lengths and SHA256.
- All **65 historical pins**, nine authority bindings, **440 compilation inputs**, and all **978 source-archive files**.
- Four DLL hashes and metadata-derived MVIDs against retained worker identities.
- Both focused workers: **13 unique passes**, matching assignments, completion records, journal hashes and DONE markers.
- Six original full-run workers: exactly **54 passing prefix rows**, zero failures. All **1,553 predecessors** retain their relative inventory order and prior shard assignments.

I executed read-only reconciliation scripts. I did **not** rerun C#, compilation, gameplay, the focused suite, supplied retainers or five-path campaigns, and I did not observe live workers. The retained compilation/static reports are evidence inspected, not my execution results.

No source correction is required from this review. Complete the same original **1,566-case run**, frozen campaign/compatibility qualification, final retention and actual final review before acceptance. Development-binary results cannot substitute.

On storage: your concern is justified. The checked-out engine’s C# files, **including tests**, total about **9.1 MB**. The LFS configuration includes older review ZIPs and large trace JSON files. After this stage, a storage audit should identify duplicate and externally archivable material while preserving required evidence and hashes. Simply deleting tracked files does not reclaim remote LFS storage. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"} No cleanup or history rewrite was performed.

scope: Actual interim checkpoint review; not final module acceptance. Owner has required a stop after EXP-07 final review, before storage investigation or successor work.
